pieces.brief: >=30 FPS at 1920x1080 on a fanless MacBook Air M2 8GB.

history.note: baseline measured 4.8 FPS p50 — 10x off target
SMAA pass cost 57ms of a 110ms frame; swapped for MSAA
ChromaticAberrationEffect is a CONVOLUTION effect forced into its own pass — ~40ms. Folded CA+grain+vignette into the grade shader as a 3-tap.
2x MSAA on a half-float target cost 4.5x frame time (56->12 FPS). Dropped MSAA at every preset; resolution scale is the dial instead.
low preset: 57.5 FPS p90 / 60.2 p50 / 120 min. Texture VRAM 302MB -> 75MB.
switched default low -> medium (0.80 scale, AO on) to bias toward image quality per direction

CRITIC: perf.mjs measured a PAUSED capture scene and included the rAF wait — over-reported ~1.8x. Real combat was p50 28.4ms with 200-790ms GC stalls, and the GPU was only ~2.6ms of a ~29ms frame. The game was CPU-bound; every rendering cut I made on "frame cost" was measured against a GPU with 90% headroom.

per-frame Vector3 allocations removed from hot paths (max 790ms -> 52ms); occlusion raycast walked 500k tris every frame — throttled + three-mesh-bvh (p50 27.3 -> 16.7ms). MSAA restored: medium 49 fps p90, high 32.9 fps p90.

shots.label: r36 · baked char AO, ambient split, MSAA

history.note: DOF blurred the entire frame incl. hero; focusDistance was normalised wrong
exposure blown, hero framed dead-centre instead of left third
261 silent shader compile errors — detail-normal injection referenced perturbNormal2Arb, removed in r185
all 7 grade metrics now inside reference bands; split-tone working (shadows -0.157 cool / highs +0.051 warm)
CRITIC: grade clipped red to zero on 7.58% of frame (ref 0.02%) — lift applied before the S-curve got mapped below zero and clamped
grade reordered S-curve->lift->tint: sat_p95 1.000->0.55 (was the only outright band failure), pure_white 0.0024->0.00038
6/7 objective gates pass; black_point is the last one out
my rewritten CA used caStrength 0.9 — displaced samples by a third of the screen, total rainbow corruption. Metrics still read 5/6 "ok" on a destroyed image.
caStrength 0.9 -> 0.015 (~2px at 1080p); image restored
lift was applied in display-LINEAR but the bands are measured in sRGB — 0.022 linear reads as 0.156 sRGB, a 7x amplification. This was the whole milky-frame cause.
removing lift unmasked real saturation AND drove 19% of frame to pure black: shadowTint was weighted (1-l)^2, i.e. strongest exactly at l=0, turning near-blacks pure blue
shadow tint gated by smoothstep(0,0.09,l); lift solved empirically at 0.002 -> black_point 0.0196, zero pure-black pixels. 8/8 gates.
CRITIC: focusRange is WORLD UNITS in postprocessing 6.39, not normalised depth. 0.035 = a 3.5cm deep field — the entire frame sat at max blur. My source comment asserted the opposite.
worldFocusRange 1.8: mid-plane detail 0.0159 -> 0.0322. Exposure 0.55 -> 1.10 (p50 0.149 -> 0.450). Split-tone finally correct: warm highs +0.039 vs ref +0.028.
Fidelity mid-detail 0.05726 vs reference 0.05722 — exact match on micro-detail

history.note: mesh + rig are good (83k tris, humanoid skeleton, 1 clip); texture atlas is the problem

CRITIC: draugr torso luma p5 was 0.329 vs reference 0.059 with 5.7% clipped white — nothing on a character was ever dark. Cut hemisphere fill 0.38->0.12, env 0.48->0.22, removed the DirectionalLight "rim" (it lit the whole back hemisphere), AO radius 1.6->0.65. Torso p5 now 0.027.
baked per-character AO in Blender (tools/bake_char_maps.py) and wired aoMap into all 4 character materials — they had none while all 11 arena materials had a full ORM set

CORRECTION: the "5.7% clipped torso" I chased for 4 rounds was a contaminated sample region — it included sunlit ground behind and between the draugr legs. Visual inspection shows the character is correctly dark and backlit. The residual clipping is ground specular.
